xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
"Poonawalla Fincorp Limited (“the Holding Company”) holds an investment in a joint venture, Jaguar Advisory Services Private Limited (“JASPL”), and is required to prepare consolidated financial statements in accordance with Ind AS 110 “Consolidated Financial Statements” read with Section 129 (3) of the Companies Act, 2013. The Board of Directors and the Shareholders of the Holding Company approved the sale of its shareholding in JASPL in their respective meetings held on November 02, 2021, and December 13, 2021. Subsequently, the Board reaffirmed its intention to divest the investment in its meeting held on April 25, 2025.

In line with Ind AS 105 “Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations,” the investment in JASPL has been classified as “assets held for sale”. Accordingly, the application of the equity method of accounting was discontinued from December 13, 2021. As a result, no share of profit or loss from JASPL has been included in the consolidated financial statements for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025.

Hence the amounts in Statement of Profit and Loss for the standalone financial results and consolidated financial results are same."
